title: SPEAR and microfluidics discover antimicrobial peptides from isolated-habitat metagenomes
summary: MicroSPEAR combines SPEAR, a sequence-structure-aware ensemble predictor, with a microfluidic susceptibility platform that cuts testing time from about 18 h to 4 h. Applied to a catalogue from 4,480 metagenomes across 15 isolated habitat types, SPEAR identified 383,027 non-redundant candidate peptides, 63.1% without detectable homologues. Of 85 synthesised candidates, 79 were antibacterial at 64 umol/l or less, and four broad-spectrum low-toxicity candidates reduced bacterial burden in a mouse thigh infection model. Preprint; four leads in one animal model.
